title: How to Advertise on Peacock: 2026 Guide

facts.fact: Universal Ads' current site describes access to NBCUniversal and other premium publishers with no platform minimum spend, according to this guide.
facts.quote: Its current site describes access to NBCUniversal and other premium publishers with no platform minimum spend.

facts.fact: Universal Ads offers 2 main campaign types: Performance+ and Content Select.
facts.quote: Advertisers can choose between 2 main campaign types:

facts.fact: Universal Ads' platform recommends beginning with 1-2 targeting layers and a simple structure.
facts.quote: The platform recommends beginning with 1-2 targeting layers, a simple structure and enough time for delivery to stabilize.

facts.fact: Universal Ads supports the Universal Ads Pixel for conversion signals.
facts.quote: It also supports the Universal Ads Pixel for conversion signals.

facts.fact: Universal Ads location targeting supports State, DMA and ZIP code inclusion or exclusion.
facts.quote: State, DMA and ZIP code inclusion or exclusion

facts.fact: Universal Ads currently documents advanced demographic targeting that includes household income, education, homeownership, family status and shopper behaviors.
facts.quote: Household income, education, homeownership, family status and shopper behaviors

facts.fact: Peacock's current advertising page highlights the products Spotlight, contextual Pause Ads and Engagement Ads, with availability depending on product, content window and commercial agreement.
facts.quote: Peacock’s current advertising page highlights products such as Spotlight, contextual Pause Ads and Engagement Ads.

facts.fact: NBCUniversal has opened selected premium events through biddable private marketplace access, per this guide.
facts.quote: It has also opened selected premium events through biddable private marketplace access.

facts.fact: This guide was published and last updated on Oct 27, 2026 and estimates a 13-minute read.
The guide advises that Peacock inventory availability must be confirmed before launch, and that Universal Ads availability should be checked in the platform forecast or in writing.
facts.quote: If Peacock is the objective, confirm it in the platform forecast or in writing before committing the media plan.
